# 282_R6FIX.19 — migration runner: single pinned connection + advisory lock + per-file tx (BL-119)

## Summary

- **Defect (BL-119, RH-A1-10):** `applyMigrations` ran over a `pg.Pool`-backed `MigrationDb` —
  `exec`, `_migrations` reads/writes could land on different connections; no advisory lock between
  concurrent migrators; a file and its bookkeeping insert were separate statements, so a crash
  left applied-but-unrecorded DDL or a half-applied file.
- **Fix:** one pinned connection for the whole run; session `pg_advisory_lock` wraps it
  (`finally` unlock); each file + its `_migrations` insert commit atomically in one tx;
  `-- no-migration-tx` first-line marker is the explicit escape hatch for future
  transaction-forbidden DDL (no current file needs it — all 63 swept clean).
- **`applyMigrationsPinned(pool)`** exported for pool callers: one `connect()`, one `release()`.
  Migrated: `apps/worker` (boot + preview-invite legs), `integration` live-bringup /
  live-migrate-seed / server-postgres test. Seeds keep the pool-level wrapper (out of scope);
  PGlite harnesses stay as-is (single-conn by construction).

## Test plan

- [x] `packages/db/src/migrate.test.ts` 8/8 — lock-order pin, mid-file crash atomicity pin
      (`to_regclass` rollback + no record + clean re-run), `applyMigrationsPinned` single-conn +
      release pin.
- [x] `@rhema/db` / `@rhema/worker` / `@rhema/integration-tests` typecheck + lint clean.
- [x] No pool-backed `applyMigrations(` remains outside PGlite harnesses.
- [x] Append-only vs `origin/main`, CURRENT STATE schema, gitleaks — clean.
